---
title: "About"
---

Awards Patterns is a fan project that tests common ideas about the Oscars against the record. The results show what happened, but they can't tell you why voters chose what they did. A handful of ceremonies can also make a pattern look stronger than it is.

## Where the data comes from

Nominees and winners come from [The Oscar Award](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/unanimad/the-oscar-award) on Kaggle (version 13), compiled by Raphael Fontes with additional data from David Lu's [oscar_data](https://github.com/DLu/oscar_data). It covers ceremonies through 2026. The dataset's uploader labels it CC0, and this site publishes only summaries and small tables built from it.

Experiments count competitive categories and leave out honorary and scientific awards. Spotted a mistake? [Open an issue](https://github.com/juliakm/awards-patterns/issues).

The project isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
